CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

2. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.

3. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

4. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   B. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   D. Damage equipment used for Netball.

6. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

7. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft.

8. Best practice when working on Middle Distance Races and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   B. Damage equipment used for Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   D. Practise Middle Distance Races and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.

10. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.

11. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

12. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   B. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

14. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   C. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.

15. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing and Painting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Craft and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
